text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌۭ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًۭا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: vocative particle initiating direct address; no lexical root is active
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) opens the ayah as a direct call, so the later avoidance, prohibitions, revulsion, and God-facing restraint all remain inside one summoned speech event. Its elongated recitational opening also slows the entry into command, making attention part of the legal setup.

topics.headline: vocative opening frames the whole ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the prohibitions as direct summons to the addressed community, not detached moral exposition.
topics.reason: The rows converge on vocative scope, direct legal address, and the delayed acoustic opening of the call.

words.gloss_range: compound vocative support and attention form linking the call to a qualified group
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuhā}}) mediates the broad call into a defined addressee class. The compound form hosts the following qualification and keeps attention focused, so identity is staged before ethics.

topics.headline: compound vocative hosts a defined community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is routed through a formally identified audience before any rule is issued.
topics.reason: The rows treat the compound as grammatical hosting, attention marking, and a formal communal-address formula.

words.gloss_range: plural relative pronoun specifying the vocative by the following qualifying act
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) completes the address by making the addressees a described class. The command is delayed until that identity is named, so the later restraints follow from who the hearers already are.

topics.headline: relative pronoun makes the audience a qualified class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the audience is addressed by a described covenant identity rather than as an unnamed crowd.
topics.reason: The rows align on apposition to the vocative compound, plural class formation, and delayed completion of the address.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect qualifying the addressed group as those who have entered faith or trust
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, safekeeping, and belief belong to the broad root field; here the completed faith-trust identity is the active local sense
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) is perfect rather than imperative: the audience is addressed as already having entered a trust-state. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) field brings security and safekeeping into that identity, while the local form keeps the sense anchored in completed faith; the following commands protect that prior trust from cognitive and verbal breaches.

topics.headline: completed trust identity grounds the prohibitions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that suspicion, spying, and backbiting are violations of the security and trust implied by the audience label itself.
topics.reason: The rows support completed qualifying status, trust-security semantics, the Form IV entry into trust, and a boundary link with 49:11; the broader root field is kept local rather than made exhaustive.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII plural imperative commanding active avoidance of a quantified portion of suspicion
words.root_gloss_range: side, flank, apartness, avoidance, and related ritual-distance branches are in the root field; here the active branch is self-imposed distancing
words.prose: {{ar:ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟}} ({{tr:ijtanibū}}) makes the believers active agents of distance: they are commanded to move themselves away from a dangerous cognitive field. The {{ar:ج ن ب}} ({{tr:j-n-b}}) side-and-flank field gives the command spatial force, while the local object keeps the command calibrated toward much suspicion rather than every possible estimate.

topics.headline: self-distancing starts the command arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels avoidance as a spatial and self-involving discipline, not a vague warning about thoughts.
topics.reason: The rows preserve imperative agency, Form VIII reflexive distance, partitive object scope, and links to the closing protection command and 49:11.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative quantity or degree term limiting the scope of avoidance
words.root_gloss_range: abundance, multiplication, and increase are active as quantity pressure here
words.prose: {{ar:كَثِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:kathīran}}) foregrounds amount before the suspicion-domain is named. Its indefinite accusative form leaves the quantity large but unnumbered, so the ayah creates a safety margin: avoid much because some will later be classified as sin.

topics.headline: quantity creates calibrated avoidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command targets much suspicion, building precaution without declaring all estimation sinful.
topics.reason: The rows converge on object-versus-degree parsing, abundance pressure, the not-all calibration, and the link between much and some.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking a partitive source and echoing separation from the suspicion-domain
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) anchors the quantity inside a source-domain. It partitions suspicion and also reinforces separation, so the command becomes targeted cognitive restraint rather than an unspecified call to avoid much.

topics.headline: partitive source binds quantity to suspicion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the avoided amount is drawn from suspicion, not left as a floating moral intensity.
topics.reason: The rows support partitive source, possible attachment to the quantity or separation verb, and tight binding to the following domain.

words.gloss_range: definite gerund naming suspicion or conjecture as the category from which much is avoided
words.root_gloss_range: the root ranges from harmful suspicion to strong expectation or near-certainty; this first local occurrence is the unstable cognitive field under partial avoidance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظَّنِّ}} ({{tr:al-ẓann}}) names a recognizable cognitive category as the object-domain of avoidance. The {{ar:ظ ن ن}} ({{tr:ẓ-n-n}}) range can include conjecture and near-certainty, so the local warning is not a total ban on thinking or estimating; it calibrates an unstable field that will be narrowed when some of it is declared sin.

topics.headline: first suspicion names a broad cognitive field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not reduce the word to bad suspicion only; the ayah regulates an epistemic field whose moral value depends on context and measure.
topics.reason: The rows support genitive source-domain grammar, definite verbal-noun category, polarity range, repetition with word 11, and the inner-to-outer harm sequence.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle introducing the nominal reason clause for the avoidance command
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) shifts from command to emphatic explanation. It makes the claim about some suspicion a settled moral ground, contrasting certainty in the speech with the uncertainty being regulated.

topics.headline: emphasis turns the reason into asserted fact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the moral reason as firm assertion precisely where hidden suspicion might be minimized.
topics.reason: The rows agree on emphatic assertion, nominal reason-clause function, resistance to minimizing inner sin, and immediate attachment to the command.

words.gloss_range: accusative construct noun marking an unspecified subset as the subject of the sin-predication
words.root_gloss_range: part, portion, and division are active here as unquantified subset language
words.prose: {{ar:بَعْضَ}} ({{tr:baʿḍa}}) is the accusative subject of the emphatic clause and forms a construct relation with suspicion. It classifies an unspecified portion, not the whole category, and its gap with the earlier much creates a preventive buffer.

topics.headline: some creates a preventive buffer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah leaves the sinful subset unnamed, requiring caution wider than proven guilt.
topics.reason: The rows support construct part-whole grammar, accusative subject of the emphatic particle, intentional non-quantification, and contrast with the earlier quantity term.

words.gloss_range: repeated definite gerund in construct with the subset term
words.root_gloss_range: the same conjecture-suspicion range remains present, now narrowed to the portion that bears moral liability
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظَّنِّ}} ({{tr:al-ẓann}}) repeats the same definite category under the subset construction. The second occurrence keeps the broad warning live while narrowing the focus to the morally load-bearing portion.

topics.headline: second suspicion narrows the same category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the explanation returns to the exact category already targeted, then narrows it rather than changing topics.
topics.reason: The rows support genitive construct role, anaphoric definiteness, and narrowing from object of avoidance to source of moral liability.

words.gloss_range: indefinite predicate classifying some suspicion as sin or moral burden
words.root_gloss_range: sin, guilt, and burden are active; supplied lagging or cumulative-burden associations are kept as semantic pressure, not a separate local sense
words.prose: {{ar:إِثْمٌۭ}} ({{tr:ithmun}}) is an indefinite predicate, so the clause classifies some suspicion as a kind of moral burden rather than listing a fixed offense. The {{ar:أ ث م}} ({{tr:ʾ-th-m}}) field lets that burden press toward agenthood, and the later consumption image gives the weight bodily form.

topics.headline: sin is made a burdening class predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the inward act become weight carried by the moral agent, anticipating the later bodily image.
topics.reason: The rows support indefinite predicate classification, compact nominal equation, burden semantics, agentive derivatives, and anticipation of eating, flesh, and death imagery.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating a new prohibition after the reason clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the discourse from the reasoned warning into a new prohibition. Its compact link starts the paired negative-command pattern that will bind spying and backbiting as outward developments from suspicion.

topics.headline: connector opens the first explicit prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees spying added as the next movement in the same ethical chain, not as an unrelated rule.
topics.reason: The rows support coordination after the reason clause, the first negative-command link, and the pairing of later prohibitions.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive particle governing the following plural verb as a negative command
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is prohibitive, so it performs restraint on the action that follows. Because the barred act is hidden investigation, the particle’s force reaches into conduct that could otherwise stay concealed.

topics.headline: prohibitive particle reaches hidden action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a command that blocks covert behavior, not a report that the behavior is absent.
topics.reason: The rows identify the particle as prohibitive rather than descriptive negation and stress its direct scope over the following verb.

words.gloss_range: prohibited Form V plural verb for spying or covert probing
words.root_gloss_range: touching, probing, spying, and repeated sensory search belong to the root field; here the local sense is invasive surveillance, with sensory-search variants used only as contrast
words.prose: {{ar:تَجَسَّسُوا۟}} ({{tr:tajassasū}}) turns the community into barred agents of covert probing. The {{ar:ج س س}} ({{tr:j-s-s}}) field begins with tactile searching and reaches espionage, so the prohibition pictures privacy violation as touching what should remain hidden; variant evidence clarifies the boundary between sensing and invasive access without replacing the local anti-surveillance sense.

topics.headline: spying becomes intrusive probing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels spying as intrusive contact with what should remain concealed, not just neutral information gathering.
topics.reason: The rows support prohibitive governance, Form V self-involved probing, tactile-to-informational semantics, variant contrast with sensory seeking, sound pressure, hapax weight, and continuation of the prohibition chain.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the second negative command with the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) repeats the connector before the second prohibition. It keeps backbiting coordinated with spying without collapsing the two, making the sequence move from covert information-gathering toward absent speech.

topics.headline: second connector pairs spying with backbiting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees backbiting as distinct from spying yet chained to it as the next social harm.
topics.reason: The rows support coordination, escalation from spying to backbiting, repeated negative-command frame, and local echo.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive particle governing a third-person singular jussive construction
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) repeats the prohibition particle but now governs a singular third-person verb. The stable particle force carries the ban across the grammatical shift, marking backbiting as a parallel offense distributed through the community.

topics.headline: second prohibition redistributes the ban
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ban shifts from a direct plural verb to a distributed no-one-within-you construction.
topics.reason: The rows support scope over the singular verb, indirect distributive force, and rhythmic pairing with the earlier prohibition.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII jussive verb under prohibition, forbidding backbiting as speech against an absent person
words.root_gloss_range: absence, hiddenness, unseenness, and backbiting belong to the root field; here the selected local sense is exploiting a person’s absence in speech
words.prose: {{ar:يَغْتَب}} ({{tr:yaghtab}}) is singular under prohibition after the plural spying command, and that grammatical distance suits a sin defined by the victim’s absence. The {{ar:غ ي ب}} ({{tr:gh-y-b}}) field of absence and hiddenness becomes social harm here: speech takes from someone who is not present to defend himself, which prepares the later image of dead helplessness.

topics.headline: absence becomes exploitable speech harm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the grammar and root making the victim unavailable to answer, preparing the dead-body analogy.
topics.reason: The rows support jussive prohibition, third-person shift, absence/unseen semantics, Form VIII taking-from-absence pressure, later divine unseen contrast in 49:18, and movement toward death imagery.

words.gloss_range: nominative partitive noun with plural addressee suffix serving as subject of backbiting
words.root_gloss_range: part, portion, division, and mutual fragmentation are active in the communal subject
words.prose: {{ar:بَّعْضُكُم}} ({{tr:baʿḍukum}}) supplies the internal subject of backbiting. The suffix keeps the agent inside the addressed community, while the partitive noun fractures the group into an acting part and a vulnerable part; with the later eating image, the community begins to consume itself.

topics.headline: some of you fractures the community from within
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the agent of backbiting as one part of the addressed body, not an outsider.
topics.reason: The rows support subject role, addressee suffix, partitive fracture, triadic repetition with words 10 and 20, and synthesis with the cannibalism image.

words.gloss_range: accusative indefinite partitive noun as object of backbiting
words.root_gloss_range: partitive division is active as the harmed counterpart to the subject-part
words.prose: {{ar:بَعْضًا}} ({{tr:baʿḍan}}) makes the harmed party another indefinite portion of the same group. The near mirror with the previous partitive form turns backbiting into the community acting against itself, with any member substitutable as victim.

topics.headline: some becomes the vulnerable object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same community-root becomes both agent and patient, making mutual harm audible.
topics.reason: The rows support direct-object function, indefiniteness, reciprocal vulnerability, and the local mirror between subject and object.

words.gloss_range: interrogative plus imperfect indicative verb asking whether one would love the imagined act
words.root_gloss_range: love, desire, and attachment are active as a rhetorical test; positive surah-local love uses remain contrastive rather than governing this inverted scene
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُحِبُّ}} ({{tr:a-yuḥibbu}}) compresses the question particle onto the love verb, making the moral test immediate. The {{ar:ح ب ب}} ({{tr:ḥ-b-b}}) field of love is inverted inside the repulsive image: the question treats the appetite as imaginable only so the later verdict can collapse it into disgust.

topics.headline: love-question forces moral recoil
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the prohibition as a self-answering question that turns desire into revulsion.
topics.reason: The rows support indicative hypothetical vividness, hidden subject resolved by the next word, interrogative rebuke, love-hate antithesis, surah-local positive love contrasts, speech-mode escalation, and the synthesis with the hate-perfect response.

words.gloss_range: singular noun with plural suffix making each member accountable inside the collective
words.root_gloss_range: oneness and singularity are active for individualization; broader divine-title associations are only distant echo and do not control the local sense
words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدُكُمْ}} ({{tr:aḥadukum}}) extracts one person from the plural audience. The singular form plus plural suffix keeps the collective frame but makes responsibility land on each member separately, after the earlier partitive language had divided the group.

topics.headline: each one is singled out inside the group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader cannot hide inside the collective because the rhetorical image asks each individual whether he would choose it.
topics.reason: The rows support singularization, one-of-you accountability, contrast with prior partitive subject, and only a limited distant echo of the broader oneness field.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive particle converting the following action into a verbal-noun complement
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) embeds the eating action as the object of the love-question. Its small form changes the following verb’s status, making the imagined cannibalistic act the preference being tested.

topics.headline: subordinator turns eating into the loved object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the question tests desire for the act itself, not mere exposure to a shocking picture.
topics.reason: The rows support governance of the following subjunctive, verbal-noun conversion, and completion of the rhetorical question content.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive Form I verb under the subordinator, governing flesh as direct object in a hypothetical image
words.root_gloss_range: physical eating, consumption, and unjust appropriation belong to the root field; here the local image is hypothetical bodily consumption mapped onto backbiting
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْكُلَ}} ({{tr:yaʾkula}}) is subjunctive under the subordinator, keeping the scene hypothetical while making it vivid. The simple Form I verb preserves bodily immediacy: backbiting is mapped as consumption, not merely compared to an abstract harm, and the direct object makes flesh the material being destroyed.

topics.headline: eating makes speech harm bodily consumption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels backbiting as consuming and destroying another person’s embodied social substance.
topics.reason: The rows support subjunctive hypothetical framing, argument structure under the love verb, direct object selection, consumption and unjust-taking semantics, extended metaphor, and sound texture.

words.gloss_range: construct noun and direct object of eating, made definite by possession by the brother
words.root_gloss_range: flesh, joining, kinship bond, and violent-body associations are present; here the local sense is concrete flesh intensified by bond-language
words.prose: {{ar:لَحْمَ}} ({{tr:laḥma}}) is the material object of the eating act and is made specific through construct possession. The {{ar:ل ح م}} ({{tr:l-ḥ-m}}) field can carry flesh and joining pressure, so the image violates both body and bond; the brotherhood declared in 49:10 returns here as a body made consumable.

topics.headline: flesh makes the brotherhood materially violated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the metaphor attack not generic meat but the tissue and bond of a brother.
topics.reason: The rows support direct-object grammar, construct definiteness, flesh-plus-bond semantics, violent image pressure, limited occurrence field, and the 49:10 brotherhood echo.

words.gloss_range: genitive possessor in the flesh construct, with suffix returning to each singular member
words.root_gloss_range: brotherhood by kinship and shared affiliation are active; local grammar makes the absent victim each person’s own brother
words.prose: {{ar:أَخِيهِ}} ({{tr:akhīhi}}) possesses the flesh in the construct phrase, so the object is not anonymous meat. The singular possessive routes back to the one member being questioned, making the imagined victim his own brother and individualizing the communal brotherhood of 49:10 at the point of violation.

topics.headline: his brother makes the victim intimate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the victim as bound to the actor by covenantal kinship, not as an anonymous target.
topics.reason: The rows support genitive possession, suffix reference, five-noun morphology, kinship and affiliation range, singular possessive force, and the 49:10 to 49:12 brotherhood movement.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative state modifying the brother or flesh in the cannibalism image
words.root_gloss_range: death, lifelessness, nonresponse, and completed deadness are active; variant process-death remains contrastive
words.prose: {{ar:مَيْتًۭا}} ({{tr:maytan}}) attaches deadness to the scene as an indefinite state, ambiguously strengthening both dead brother and carrion-flesh readings. The {{ar:م و ت}} ({{tr:m-w-t}}) field makes nonresponse central: the absent victim cannot defend himself, while variant evidence can intensify deterioration without displacing the base reading of completed helplessness.

topics.headline: deadness makes absence defenseless
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why absence matters: the victim is imagined as unable to answer, like dead flesh unable to resist consumption.
topics.reason: The rows support accusative state ambiguity, helplessness, completed-death versus process-death contrast, and concentration of eating, flesh, and death fields.

words.gloss_range: conclusive-resultative particle pivoting from question to verdict
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) attaches the answer to the rhetorical image. It moves the discourse from an open question-form into a declarative conclusion, making revulsion the necessary result of imagining the act.

topics.headline: result particle closes the rhetorical case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the imagined question snap into a settled verdict of disgust.
topics.reason: The rows support result from question to verdict, immediate attachment to the disgust clause, and closure of the rhetorical case.

words.gloss_range: perfect verb with second-person plural subject and third-person object pronoun declaring the imagined act detested
words.root_gloss_range: hate, aversion, compulsion, and legal dislike belong to the root field; here aversion is the selected local force, with passive variant as caused-moral-formation contrast
words.prose: {{ar:كَرِهْتُمُوهُ}} ({{tr:karihtumūhu}}) answers the love-question with a perfect-tense verdict, treating revulsion as already accomplished even though the scene was hypothetical. The attached subject and object bind the community directly to the detested act or image, while variant evidence can externalize caused aversion without replacing the local active verdict.

topics.headline: detested verdict recruits the audience against the act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader supplies the condemnation: the question about love is answered as already-settled communal aversion.
topics.reason: The rows support referential breadth of the object pronoun, perfect-as-settled disgust, love-hate antithesis, compact suffix binding, passive variant contrast, audience participation, and the 49:7 hate-field echo.

words.gloss_range: conjunction resuming instruction after the disgust verdict
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the legal address after the disgust verdict. It does not erase the image; it carries its force forward into the final command, turning recoil into protective discipline.

topics.headline: resumptive connector turns disgust into command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees emotional recoil redirected into God-conscious protective action.
topics.reason: The rows support transition from analogy to command, formally light but decisive pivot, and movement from disgust to protection.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII plural imperative commanding active God-facing self-shielding
words.root_gloss_range: guarding, shielding, protection, and self-protective restraint are active here; generic inward piety alone is too flat for this local command
words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّقُوا۟}} ({{tr:ittaqū}}) returns the discourse to direct plural command after the individualized test. The {{ar:و ق ي}} ({{tr:w-q-y}}) shielding field makes the command concrete: the addressees must actively undertake protective restraint through God, so the arc moves from avoidance and prohibitions into affirmative self-shielding.

topics.headline: protective taqwā closes the prohibition arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the negative prohibitions resolved as active protective restraint against social harm.
topics.reason: The rows support second-person imperative, guarding and shielding semantics, Form VIII self-directed protection, formulaic command phrase, surah-local recurrence in 49:1 and 49:10, and closure of the prohibition arc.

words.gloss_range: accusative proper divine name as the object of the protection command
words.root_gloss_range: worship, divinity, and resort or refuge associations are broad root-analysis pressure; locally the proper divine name is the command’s specific object
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) is the accusative object of the protection command. The local force is the proper divine name as the orientation of shielding, so restraint after social violation is God-facing rather than merely a communal code.

topics.headline: divine name orients the shielding command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the social restraints grounded in accountability to the named Divine, not in etiquette alone.
topics.reason: The rows support object grammar, proper-name specificity, divine accountability, root-analysis pressure kept narrow, and same-surah divine anchoring.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the closing nominal clause of divine return and mercy
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) repeats the emphatic particle before the closing attributes. The ayah’s two emphatic clauses bracket moral liability and restoration: the first makes some suspicion sin, and this one makes return and mercy equally asserted.

topics.headline: second emphasis asserts the mercy seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ending as firm assurance, not optional consolation after severity.
topics.reason: The rows support emphatic mercy clause, repeated form, resistance points around hidden sin and mercy, and the bracket from sin-declaration to mercy-declaration.

words.gloss_range: accusative subject of the closing emphatic clause with two divine predicates
words.root_gloss_range: divine proper-name reference is active; the broader root-analysis field is not expanded beyond the named subject of the attributes
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) becomes the subject of the closing emphatic clause, with the two following attributes jointly defining the response. Repeating the divine name after the command keeps God audible both as the object of restraint and as the source of return and mercy.

topics.headline: repeated divine name links command and assurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the divine name repeated instead of pronominally hidden, linking obligation to restoration.
topics.reason: The rows support subject of the closing clause, paired predicates, explicit repetition rather than pronoun, and the boundary movement from human repentance in 49:11 to divine availability in 49:12.

words.gloss_range: first indefinite intensive predicate naming God as repeatedly turning toward repentance
words.root_gloss_range: return, repentance, reversal, and repeated divine turning are active; the word names divine initiative rather than merely human repentance
words.prose: {{ar:تَوَّابٌۭ}} ({{tr:tawwābun}}) is the first predicate in the closing clause, so return is named before mercy completes the seal. The {{ar:ت و ب}} ({{tr:t-w-b}}) return-field and the intensive pattern make the attribute repeated and divine: after suspicion, spying, and backbiting, the ayah opens a repair path without softening the offense.

topics.headline: repeated divine return opens the repair path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the severe social breach answered by an ongoing divine attribute that makes return possible.
topics.reason: The rows support paired predicate grammar, first-predicate position, divine repeated turning, return as reversal, intensive pattern, indefinite attribute quality, restoration pair parallels at 2:37 and 9:118, boundary links with 49:11, and the prevention-plus-repair synthesis.

words.gloss_range: second indefinite intensive predicate completing the divine attribute seal
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, womb-linked nurture, reciprocal mercy, and sustained compassion are active as closing restoration; etymological pressure supports the image without replacing divine mercy
words.prose: {{ar:رَّحِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:raḥīmun}}) completes the paired-predicate closure, making mercy part of the same asserted divine identity as repeated return. The {{ar:ر ح م}} ({{tr:r-ḥ-m}}) field brings intimate nurture and mutual repair into the landing point: after the image of a brother’s flesh, the final word answers social violence with sustained compassion.

topics.headline: mercy completes the restorative landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah land not on disgust alone but on restoring compassion after social violence.
topics.reason: The rows support second-predicate grammar, womb-mercy pressure, reciprocal mercy after mutual harm, matching indefinite predicate form, sustained intensive quality, restoration-formula parallels at 2:37, 4:16, and 9:118, final-seal placement, and tanwīn cadence.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from repeated ظن through تجسس and يغتب to eating a dead brother's flesh.
baseline_models.mechanism: Uncertain supposition is converted into a target by covert news-gathering; mention of the absent then turns concealed personal material into consumable speech and discord. The corpse image is the endpoint of an epistemic escalation, not an ornamental comparison.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain supposition supplies the unstable premise that the later acts try to harden.
Covert tracking of news turns an inward suspicion into an information-gathering act.
Hiddenness supplies the protected material that the probe seeks to expose.
Mention in absence converts the discovered material into injurious circulation.
The branch's discord-stirring and tale-bearing image makes social consumption part of eating itself.
Flesh gives the exposed person a vulnerable bodily substance that speech can consume.
Carrion makes the absent brother defenseless and unavailable to consent or reply.

changed_reading.before: Suspicion, spying, and backbiting are three adjacent prohibitions followed by a vivid simile.
changed_reading.after: They form a causal conversion chain: weak inference becomes covert extraction, then absent-person speech, then predatory social consumption.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: اجتنبوا كثيرا من الظن followed by إن بعض الظن إثم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The shift from 'many' to 'some', together with opposed branches of ظن, sorts judgments rather than erasing judgment. The danger is an abundance of low-indication suppositions among which some impede good; certainty responsibly grounded in indication remains a live coexisting category.

activation_trace.role: Abundance makes the command a discipline of proliferating judgments rather than one isolated thought.
Certainty after an indication preserves a possible responsible mode of judgment.
Weak supposition marks the epistemically unstable mode that needs restraint.
Partitioning prevents the warning about sinful suspicion from flattening every ظن into one class.
Sin as lagging from good renders bad suspicion obstructive, not merely incorrect.

changed_reading.before: The verse bans suspicion as a single undifferentiated mental state.
changed_reading.after: It demands epistemic triage: resist proliferating weak suppositions because some become morally obstructive, while not denying every indicated judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from آمنوا and اجتنبوا through تجسسوا and يغتب to اتقوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A community of trust requires an informational membrane. Keeping aside preserves distance; palpating with senses breaches what is hidden; protective caution restores the barrier. The object protected is not secrecy in the abstract but the other person's unoffered interior.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust name the social condition that invasive inquiry destroys.
Keeping aside supplies deliberate distance from the protected interior.
Knowing by gentle touch makes even a subtle probe a boundary-crossing diagnostic act.
Sense organs supply the apparatus by which curiosity reaches across the boundary.
Being hidden from sight or knowledge defines the interior that is not automatically available.
A protective barrier turns taqwa into the closing structural answer to intrusion.

changed_reading.before: The verse tells individuals to suppress curiosity and gossip.
changed_reading.after: It establishes a social membrane: trust depends on preserving another person's right not to be palpated, sensed, or exposed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three occurrences of بعض around أخيه, لحمه, and ميتا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated portioning cuts a communal whole into speaker, target, and consumed fragment. Yet flesh also joins and kinship tethers; stripping flesh from bone therefore figures backbiting as dismembering the very relation that holds the speakers together.

activation_trace.role: Partition into portions gives the repeated بعض a dismembering pressure across thought and speech.
Joining and adhering makes flesh connective tissue as well as edible matter.
The kinship branch joins bodily flesh directly to the brother relation.
Stripping flesh from bone supplies the destructive action performed on the shared body.
The tethering bond makes brotherhood a relation whose severing harms both ends.
Loss of vitality makes the targeted member unable to participate in or repair the speech event.

changed_reading.before: Backbiting harms another member of the group.
changed_reading.after: Backbiting portions and strips a body held together by kinship; the speaker consumes connective tissue belonging to the same communal body.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أيحب أحدكم أن يأكل ... فكرهتموه followed by واتقوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question catches love as clinging appetite, fuses tale-bearing with eating, and turns that appetite into aversion. Protective caution then stabilizes the reversal. The verse acts on desire, not only on rule-compliance.

activation_trace.role: Clinging attachment supplies the appetite whose object the question exposes.
The heart's inner kernel locates the appetite at the center of valuation rather than at the mouth alone.
Literal ingestion gives the social act its bodily appetite and incorporation.
Discord-stirring and tale-bearing keep the eating image attached to the prohibited speech.
Aversion opposite satisfaction performs the desired reversal of appetite.
Self-protective caution holds the newly repelled appetite in practice.

changed_reading.before: The corpse simile shocks the listener into obeying a prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The simile is an affective operation: it reveals attachment to injurious speech, recodes it as carrion appetite, and trains love into aversion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The close إن الله تواب رحيم after the flesh-eating image.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ending does not leave the offender fixed as predator. Sin delays good, but flesh can also close a wound, repentance remains callable, and mercy includes kinship. The close opens a return from consumed relation toward repaired attachment.

activation_trace.role: Lagging from good makes the offense a reversible obstruction rather than a final identity.
A wound reaching or closing with flesh activates bodily repair after the stripping image.
The invitation-to-repent image keeps the offender addressable after the horror.
Tender mercy supplies the affective condition for repair.
Kinship makes mercy restore the same relational field that brother-flesh marked as damaged.

changed_reading.before: The final divine names are a general assurance after severe warning.
changed_reading.after: They complete the body's logic: consumed kinship can still be recalled, the wound can close, and the offender can return without being reduced to the offense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early context supplies a choreography of access: do not advance, do not demand from behind an enclosure, and wait for voluntary emergence. This spatial etiquette strengthens the focus ayah's informational membrane: another person's concealed interior is approached by permission and disclosure, not breached by diagnostic touch.

activation_trace.role: Keeping aside anchors the focus command in deliberate non-encroachment.
Diagnostic touch names the subtle breach that the spatial sequence illuminates.
Advancing ahead supplies the prohibited movement of crossing an order of access.
Covering something behind backs supplies concealment that remains in place until offered.
Prevention and enclosure give the chambers a real boundary function in the analogy.
Holding oneself back supplies the alternative to forced access: waiting.

structural_cues: 49:1 forbids advancing ahead; 49:4-5 contrasts calling from behind chambers with waiting for an invited exit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance, enclosure, concealment, and waiting; I map that physical access sequence onto access to a person's hidden condition. The live alternative is that these are only protocols of prophetic etiquette, but the focus roots still sustain the boundary analogy.

changed_reading.before: Do not spy means do not gather private facts.
changed_reading.after: Do not spy also means do not force an interior to emerge; ethical access waits at the boundary for disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:6 routes an incoming report through accountable clarification before a people become its target. Against that route, تجسس appears as counterfeit verification: suspicion bypasses open clarification, searches covertly, and still produces a struck social target and belated regret.

activation_trace.role: Weak supposition is the unverified starting state shared by the harmful route.
Covert tracking names the illicit substitute for accountable clarification.
A delivered report supplies the external claim that must not move directly into action.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies the public evidentiary checkpoint.
Aiming and hitting a target exposes the social consequence of failed verification.
Absence of knowledge marks action taken before the evidentiary gap is repaired.
Regret after a missed opportunity supplies the irreversible lag behind injury.

structural_cues: 49:6 orders report, clarification, possible impact on a people, ignorance, and remorse as a consequence sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the 49:6 sequence; I treat covert probing in 49:12 as a rival route for resolving uncertainty and infer that it lacks the accountable checkpoint. The alternative is that 49:6 concerns public reports while 49:12 concerns privacy, but that difference sharpens rather than removes the contrast.

changed_reading.before: Spying may look like overzealous fact-checking before speaking.
changed_reading.after: The context separates verification from spying: responsible inquiry clarifies an offered report before impact, while covert inquiry manufactures a target from suspicion.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:7 describes faith made beloved, beautified in hearts, and wrongdoing made hated. The focus ayah reuses love and hate around eating, so its corpse scene can function as the local performance of that formation: an injurious appetite is shown its object and its valuation is turned.

activation_trace.role: Clinging love supplies the focus question's exposed appetite.
Tale-bearing as eating identifies the appetite being morally revalued.
Aversion opposite satisfaction is the focus scene's achieved affective reversal.
Love clinging to the heart supplies the positive side of formed desire.
Making something appear beautiful explains how an object becomes affectively attractive.
Turning a thing from its face activates the heart as a site where valuation can reverse.
Made aversion supplies the context's negative side of moral formation.

structural_cues: 49:7 coordinates made-beloved, beautified in hearts, and made-hated before 49:12 asks about loving an act and declares aversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated love/hate roots and heart-centered valuation; I infer that the focus simile performs the retraining described earlier. The live alternative is that disgust only intensifies prohibition, but the repeated affective architecture supports a formative reading.

changed_reading.before: The listener already hates the imagined act, and the verse merely exploits that reaction.
changed_reading.after: The verse actively reforms desire: it transfers the moral ugliness of backbiting into felt bodily aversion and makes disgust a trained ethical capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:9-10 repeatedly repairs what stands between believers, balances the relation, and names them brothers. The focus image then becomes the inverse operation: absent speech consumes connective flesh instead of restoring the tether. Abstention is therefore incomplete without relational repair.

activation_trace.role: Joining and adhering make brother-flesh the connective material that gossip damages.
The tethering bond gives the harmed relation two connected ends.
Removing estrangement supplies the active repair opposed to absent-person speech.
A connection standing between parties gives repair a relational site rather than two isolated selves.
A straight balance supplies the non-predatory way to handle conflict and competing claims.
The repeated brother tether makes reconciliation the expected motion within the collective body.

structural_cues: 49:9 repeats reconciliation around return and justice; 49:10 compresses believers into brotherhood and again commands repair between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated repair, between-ness, balance, and brotherhood; I infer that the flesh image depicts the connective relation those acts should restore. The alternative is a narrower ban on speech, but the nearby repair sequence gives abstention a positive sequel.

changed_reading.before: The remedy for backbiting is to stop speaking about the absent person.
changed_reading.after: Stopping predation is only the first move; the larger mechanism restores what stands between tethered siblings and closes damaged connective tissue.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:11 moves from ridicule and faulting 'yourselves' to reciprocal labeling. A name can become a public sign that fixes one fault as the person's identity. The focus ayah's repeated portions and absent mention then expose backbiting as a reflexive classificatory wound: a fragment is detached, named, and circulated against the common self.

activation_trace.role: Portioning supplies the fragment of a person that speech detaches and treats as the whole.
Mention in absence is the channel through which the detached fragment circulates.
Ridicule supplies the social pleasure that turns another into an object.
Faulting supplies the selected defect that speech detaches from a fuller person.
The thing itself or self makes injury to another member reflexively an injury to yourselves.
A name as public designation and sign supplies the mechanism that stabilizes a fault into identity.

structural_cues: 49:11 makes the object of faulting 'yourselves' and proceeds from mockery through reciprocal naming.
ن ب ز at 49:11[27] and ل ق ب at 49:11[28] are branchless packet cues used only for the reciprocal naming structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ridicule, fault, self-reference, and naming; I infer the arrow from selecting a fault to fixing and circulating it as identity. The alternative is that 49:11 and 49:12 list separate speech harms, but the self-reference and partitive repetition support a shared wound mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Backbiting reports a real or alleged fault while the person is absent.
changed_reading.after: Backbiting is identity manufacture: it cuts out one fault, fixes it as a public sign, and wounds the speaker's own collective self.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:13 does not answer hiddenness with ignorance; branching peoples can gather, face one another, and recognize by offered signs. That supplies the ethical counterpart to تجسس: reciprocal recognition honors presented identity, whereas covert probing extracts what has not been presented.

activation_trace.role: Covert news-tracking supplies the unilateral knowledge practice being contrasted.
Hiddenness marks material that reciprocal encounter has not offered.
Branching and dispersal preserve real difference rather than dissolving it.
Gathering and mending a split show that differentiated branches can enter relation without covert fusion.
Groups facing one another supply reciprocity and visible encounter.
Recognition by trace or sign supplies knowledge responsive to what appears rather than invasive excavation.

structural_cues: 49:13 places created differentiation before the reciprocal form لتعارفوا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiated groups, face-to-face collectivity, and recognition by signs; I infer reciprocity as the ethical axis distinguishing recognition from spying. The alternative is that 49:13 concerns intergroup identity rather than privacy, but both readings can coexist because the focus remains anchored in how knowledge is acquired.

changed_reading.before: The prohibition of spying favors knowing less about other people.
changed_reading.after: It favors a different way of knowing: mutual, face-to-face recognition through offered signs instead of unilateral extraction from hiddenness.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:14 distinguishes a spoken identity claim from faith entering the heart; 49:15 names unsettled doubt; 49:16 contrasts telling God one's religion with God's disclosure-free knowledge. The focus sequence can therefore be read as a warning against acting as if suspicion grants entry into another's inward reality.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain supposition supplies the unstable judgment about another's interior.
Diagnostic touch supplies the attempted entry from supposition into claimed knowledge.
The inward and secret interior marks the heart's reality as distinct from public profession.
Agitated doubt supplies an interior state that cannot safely become another person's verdict.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower marks the complete knowledge explicitly assigned to God.
Entrusting or attesting religion supplies the claimed identity humans presume to present as settled knowledge.

structural_cues: 49:14 separates saying 'we believe' from faith entering hearts; 49:16 contrasts announcing religion to God with God's knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claim/interior disparity and divine knowledge; I infer that human suspicion plus probing counterfeits entry into that interior. The live alternative is that these verses police one's own sincerity, yet that uncertainty itself limits confident classification of others.

changed_reading.before: Suspicion is dangerous mainly because it may be factually false.
changed_reading.after: Suspicion becomes dangerous when it is treated as unauthorized interior access and hardened into a verdict about who another person really is.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:17 portrays reminded favor as weight placed on its recipient and as a cut in relational continuity. This activates a non-food branch of eating in the focus ayah: backbiting can consume social credit, turning intimacy or past generosity into leverage over a tethered brother.

activation_trace.role: Consuming or taking another's wealth extends eating from food to extractive appropriation.
The tethered bond supplies the relation from which social credit is extracted.
Firm interlacing supplies the continuity that leverage and exposure pull apart.
Reminding a recipient of a favor supplies speech that burdens another with one's gift.
Cutting and diminishing until continuity ends supplies the relational result of such leverage.

structural_cues: 49:17 repeats the favor claim, reverses its subject, and denies the speaker ownership of the other person's guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burdening reminder and severed continuity; I transfer that extraction pattern to the focus eating/kinship complex. The alternative is that 49:17 only corrects boasting before the Messenger, so the social-credit reading remains exploratory rather than a lexical gloss of backbiting.

changed_reading.before: Eating flesh represents only the consumption of reputation through hostile speech.
changed_reading.after: It can also expose a creditor-like appetite: converting shared history, gifts, or intimacy into consumable leverage over a brother.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final context assigns knowledge of the unseen and comprehensive sight of deeds to God. Human تجسس, by contrast, mobilizes the senses to eliminate uncertainty about another. The prohibition thus becomes epistemic restraint: human community can act responsibly without claiming total surveillance.

activation_trace.role: The organs of sensing supply the finite human apparatus recruited by surveillance.
Hiddenness marks the limit that human probing tries to erase.
Complete disclosure to the knower supplies the knowledge explicitly predicated of God.
The unseen hidden from eyes names the domain whose knowledge is divinely held.
Visual seeing supplies direct observation without the human covert-probe mechanism.
Insight of the heart extends divine seeing beyond exposed surfaces.

structural_cues: 49:18 closes the context by pairing God's knowledge of the unseen with God's sight of what people do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine unseen-knowledge and sight after the human spying prohibition; I infer an asymmetry that asks humans to relinquish total epistemic control. The alternative is a general warning of accountability, which can coexist with the anti-surveillance reading.

changed_reading.before: Do not spy because private information is socially dangerous.
changed_reading.after: Do not spy because finite agents need not and must not imitate total sight; responsible relation includes yielding some hiddenness to divine knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from focus ء ك ل to ك ل ل; it remains anchored in repeated بعض and يأكل, but downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant resonance, never as the lexical meaning of يأكل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Repeated بعض around يأكل and the split ء ك ل inventory's totality branch.

activation_trace.role: Partition supplies the partial suspicion or fault selected from a larger person.
The split branch's totality and completeness image supplies the jump from one fragment to a total verdict.
Absent mention circulates the totalized verdict where the fuller person cannot interrupt it.

changed_reading.before: Backbiting consumes a piece of the absent person's reputation.
changed_reading.after: It first totalizes: one partial suspicion becomes the whole person, and that manufactured whole is then consumed in speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This hunting-and-wound model is materially strange but all of its branches occur in the focus ayah and converge on the dead-flesh scene; it should be rendered as an image-level mechanism, not as a claim that the verse literally describes hunting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تجسسوا, يأكل, لحم, and ميتا within the single predatory simile.

activation_trace.role: Palpation to know a condition supplies the search for a vulnerable point.
Eaten prey or an animal set aside for eating turns the target into quarry.
A wound reaching flesh supplies the discovered weakness that can be exploited.
Checking whether wounded game is dead supplies the final test that the target cannot resist.

changed_reading.before: The absent brother is passive because death intensifies the horror of eating flesh.
changed_reading.after: The sequence resembles predation: probe for a wound, establish defenselessness, and convert the brother from interlocutor into consumable quarry.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ecological image is branch-distant, yet it is anchored by focus غيب's hidden-tree-roots branch, diagnostic probing, and flesh as kinship; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for concealed support, not a lexical paraphrase of backbiting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تجسسوا and يغتب beside the brother/kinship flesh complex.

activation_trace.role: Touch used to discover condition supplies the excavating probe.
Hidden tree roots supply concealed structures that nourish what is visible.
Kinship makes the buried support relational rather than merely botanical.
The tethering bond supplies the living connection damaged by excavation and exposure.

changed_reading.before: Spying uncovers a hidden fact about an individual.
changed_reading.after: Spying digs into hidden relational roots; exposing them can injure the unseen supports by which the shared body remains connected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is especially form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ه د ي to ه د د split branch; it remains anchored by focus ظن and the closing turn toward repentance, but prose must label it a cross-root resonance rather than a meaning of هدى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated ظن and the closing تواب within 49:12, activated by 49:17's هدى cue.

activation_trace.role: Weak supposition supplies the self-generated projection from which the focus command withdraws.
The split branch's image of casting imagined suspicion into the self supplies a startling negative foil to guidance.
Calling to repentance supplies a possible return from projection-driven judgment.

changed_reading.before: The close offers pardon after failures of suspicion and speech.
changed_reading.after: The close can also mark reorientation: relinquishing projections generated within the self so that guidance, rather than imagined suspicion, directs relation.

strongest_changes: The prohibitions became a causal chain from weak inference through covert extraction to predatory circulation.
49:6 separated accountable verification from spying as a counterfeit route to certainty.
49:7 turned the corpse scene into active retraining of love, appetite, and aversion.
49:9-13 supplied positive alternatives: repair of connective brotherhood and reciprocal recognition through offered signs.
49:18 reframed non-spying as acceptance of the asymmetry between finite human sensing and divine knowledge of the unseen.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several coexisting mechanisms without collapse: epistemic escalation, a consent-like social boundary, dismemberment of a collective body, affective reformation, and reparable kinship. Split mappings also exposed contained but live resonances in which a partial fault becomes a total person and guidance displaces projected suspicion.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrows from suspicion to probing to backbiting are reconstructed from sequence and branch fit, not explicitly marked as necessary steps by grammar.
The verification/spying and recognition/spying contrasts may be contextual juxtapositions rather than direct formal oppositions.
The communal-body and wound-closing models depend on material branches of ل ح م that may remain imagistic rather than interpretively governing.
The ء ك ل to ك ل ل and ه د ي to ه د د activations are deliberately retained split-root outliers and must not be lexicalized.
The branchless ن ب ز and ل ق ب cues support only the structure of reciprocal labeling; no branch identity is inferred for them.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Suspicion must remain genuinely plural.** ظ ن ن B001 (certainty after an indication), B002 (expected sign), B003 (uncertain supposition), and B005 (habitual bad suspicion) are all activated by "much" versus "some." The quantifiers refuse a total ban on inference. I infer that the ethical task is to separate evidence-settled judgment from accusatory habit. The ayah becomes a classification discipline for cognition.
2. **Covert inquiry crosses a protected side.** ج ن ب B003 is keeping aside/avoiding and B011 a shield held at the side; ج س س B001/B002/B004 gives gentle touch, covert news-tracking, and visual probing; غ ي ب B001 supplies what is hidden. The command sequence moves from keeping suspicion aside to forbidding probing and absent mention. I infer that another's hidden side is a shielded boundary. Curiosity becomes violation when it converts uncertainty into sensory intrusion.
3. **Backbiting consumes the tissue that joins kin.** ء ك ل B001 is eating and B006 being eaten away; ل ح م B001 gives flesh, B005 joining/adhering, and B007 kinship bond; ء خ و B001 gives brotherhood. The corpse image is explicit. I infer that absent speech feeds on and decays the same connective tissue that makes the speakers kin. The image diagnoses social self-consumption.
4. **The victim's stillness removes reciprocity, not relation.** م و ت B001 gives death and B012 lifeless stillness; ب ع ض B001 repeatedly portions the community. The dead brother cannot answer, while each "part" remains part of the whole. I infer that nonresponse makes consumption easier but cannot sever membership. The grotesque question restores the absent party's embodied claim.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 49:13's *taʿāruf* appeared as the positive counterpart to spying: mutual recognition follows offered traces, whereas covert probing takes what remains shielded. The exhaustive divine knowledge of 49:16-18 then fixed the asymmetry: humans must not seize hidden interiors, while God already knows and sees them.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The command is epistemic side-keeping, not a ban on every inference.** `ج ن ب:B003` means putting aside, avoiding, or keeping distance. The quantified wording distinguishes “much” and “some,” while the inventory distinguishes `ظ ن ن:B001`, strong belief after an indication, from `ظ ن ن:B003`, weak supposition, `ظ ن ن:B004`, accusation, and `ظ ن ن:B005`, habitual bad suspicion. Report verification in 49:6 and the contrast between human and divine knowledge in 49:16 supply the epistemic frame. The packet gives these distinctions; I infer that **ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟** quarantines unreliable inference before it acquires accusatory force.

2. **Suspicion recruits the senses into covert invasion.** `ج س س:B001` is learning a condition by gentle palpation and `ج س س:B004` probing by sight, while `ج س س:B002` covertly tracks reports. Placed after suspect judgment and before mention in absence (`غ ي ب:B004`), spying becomes a bridge from inward supposition to externally gathered private material. The packet supplies the sequence but not the causal arrow; I infer that the urge to convert weak suspicion into certainty misuses diagnostic perception by crossing another’s protected side. The verse therefore interrupts an escalating information practice, not three unrelated vices.

3. **Backbiting consumes the connective tissue of brotherhood.** `ل ح م:B001` supplies literal flesh, but `ل ح م:B005` is joining what was separate, `ل ح م:B006` the interwoven weft, and `ل ح م:B007` a kinship bond. Conversely, `ء ك ل:B006` is erosion or being eaten away and `ء ك ل:B009` stirring discord among people. Brotherhood (`ء خ و:B001`, with the tethering bond `ء خ و:B002`) and the repeated portions of **بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا** (`ب ع ض:B001`) supply the social structure. I infer that absent-person speech consumes the very adhesion by which separate members form one body. The image changes from sheer disgust to a material model of relational disintegration.

4. **Death removes reply while speech continues to use the absent person as provision.** `م و ت:B001` is loss of vitality and life; `غ ي ب:B001` is absence from sight or human knowledge; and `ء ك ل:B003` can make what is eaten an allotted provision. The packet gives a dead, absent brother as the object but does not state the asymmetry; I infer that backbiting turns someone who cannot answer into consumable social material for those present. This sharpens the offense as exploitation of disabled agency.

5. **The disgust question retrains the same affective faculty configured in 49:7.** `ح ب ب:B002` supplies love or preference, and `ك ر ه:B001` supplies aversion; 49:7 previously made faith beloved and boundary-breaking conduct hateful. Here a sensory image makes the audience supply the aversion themselves, followed by protective caution (`و ق ي:B002`). The packet gives the earlier divine affective ordering and this interrogative reversal; I infer that the image turns abstract prohibition into an internal repulsion capable of stopping the chain. The available `ت و ب:B003` specifically concerns calling another to repent and includes return and remorse; cautiously, it activates the closing **تَوَّابٌ** as keeping a route of return open after the appetite has been corrected.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 49:18 clarifies why spying is not a human imitation of divine knowledge: God knows `غ ي ب:B001` and sees deeds directly (`ب ص ر:B001`, `ب ص ر:B002`), whereas humans cross boundaries through `ج س س:B002` and `ج س س:B004`. The final ayah turns this prohibition into a boundary of epistemic competence.

baseline.text: Ey iman edenler! Zannın çoğundan kaçının; çünkü zannın bir kısmı günahtır. Birbiriniz hakkında gizlice araştırma yapmayın ve birbirinizin arkasından konuşmayın. Biriniz ölmüş kardeşinin etini yemeyi sever mi? Ondan tiksindiniz. Allah'a karşı gelmekten sakının. Şüphesiz Allah tövbeleri çokça kabul edendir, merhametlidir.

findings.text: Zannın türleri ayrılmalıdır: işarete dayanan güçlü kanaat ile zayıf varsayım, suçlama ve alışkanlık hâline gelmiş kötü kuşku aynı hükme sokulmaz.
Şüphe, duyuları gizli haber izlemeye ve görsel yoklamaya seferber ettiğinde, başkasının korunmuş özel alanını aşan bir bilgi istilasına dönüşür.
Gıybet, ayrı kişileri kardeşlikte birleştiren dokuyu yiyip aşındırır; ölü et imgesi ilişkisel çözülmenin maddi modelidir.
Ölü ve gıyabındaki kardeşin cevap verememesi, onu hazır bulunanların kullanabileceği toplumsal malzemeye çevirmeyi daha ağır bir sömürü yapar.
Tiksinti sorusu, 49:7'de iman için sevgi ve sınır ihlali için nefret olarak düzenlenen duyguyu, gıybet zincirini içeriden durduracak bedensel bir isteksizliğe dönüştürür.
Tövbeye çağırma ve geri dönüş boyutu, düzeltilmiş iştahtan sonra dönüş yolunun açık kaldığını düşündürür; bu bağ kapanış sıfatında ancak dolaylıdır.
Casusluk yasağı, insanın gizliye erişim yetkisini Allah'ın görmesiyle karıştırmaması gereken bilgi sınırını da kurar.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A protected interior is approached across a boundary whose crossing must be authorized, patient, and inwardly completed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Architectural enclosure becomes a model for reason, piety, pardon, and the difference between an exterior declaration and an admitted interior state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covering as Protection and Pardon
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A vulnerable interior is preserved by shielding, avoidance, and a cover that can also conceal fault.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: shielding from harm `quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`; placing oneself within protection `quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`; protective covering `quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`; covering a fault in pardon `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; atonement that covers a wrong `quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`; moving aside from danger `quranic:root_000262:B003/m01`; reason as a restraining barrier `quranic:root_000296:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: protection occurs at 49:1, 3, 10, 12, and 13; pardon at 49:3, 5, and 14; covering at 49:7; avoidance at 49:12; the chamber root at 49:4.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Protection is assembled from several compatible operations: a barrier restrains approach, the self moves aside from exposure, and a cover prevents injury or covers an already committed fault. Pardon and atonement extend that cover from prevention to repair. The chamber boundary is thus reframed as an ethical technology protecting both what is within and the person who might otherwise trespass.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Epistemic discipline is materialized as target practice, unmarked terrain, tactile probing, a dawn raid, and the cleaning of a well until what it holds becomes visible.

Marks and descriptions can identify what is sought, but an unreliable source cannot sustain confidence about its outcome. This boundary blocks the slide from limited evidence into accusation and invasive search.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Fractured relations are restored by stopping violence, rejoining separated parts, and setting the whole to a just line and measure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Social repair takes material form as patching a vessel, draining a wound, setting a bone, hearing a grievance, balancing a load, and weaving kinship tissue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Patching the Cracked Vessel
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Split material is brought edge-to-edge, stitched or soldered, and made fit to hold its contents again.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: mending a crack `quranic:root_000797:B002/m01`; patched water skin whose seams can leak `quranic:root_000797:B007/m01`; soldering or joining a fissure `quranic:root_001348:B005/m01`; stitching two hides or cloth edges `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`; repair after corruption `quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`; restored fit and suitability `quranic:root_000876:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: repair occurs at 49:9-10; flesh/solder at 49:12; branching and patched-vessel imagery at 49:13; sight/stitching at 49:18.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This repair operation concerns continuity and function, not bodily recovery. Edges must meet, the joining material must hold, and the vessel must again suit its purpose without leaking. Reconciliation is thereby pictured as restoration of a shared container rather than mere proximity of its pieces.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A wound is drained and filled, a broken bone is set, and the repair is guarded against renewed corruption.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a wound filling and healing `quranic:root_001348:B008/m01`; setting a broken bone `quranic:root_000015:B002/m01`; refracturing a bone `quranic:root_001051:B004/m01`; relapse of a wound `quranic:root_001096:B004/m01`; wound swelling toward corruption `quranic:root_000138:B004/m01`; pus collected in a wound `quranic:root_000281:B006/m01`; abscess emerging from the body `quranic:root_000400:B004/m01`; wound reopening and leaving a trace `quranic:root_000289:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: wound invalidation occurs at 49:2; setting at 49:3; abscess/emergence at 49:5; pus/arrival at 49:6; refracture at 49:7; wound corruption/aggression at 49:9; flesh at 49:12; relapse/covering at 49:3, 5, and 14.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The sequence separates initial closure from durable recovery. Pus and swelling must leave the interior, the fracture must be set, and relapse can still undo apparent healing. This materially pressures both reconciliation and the warning that a completed work can be nullified after it seemed secure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What enters or leaves the mouth can violate a protected relation and spread corruption through a social or bodily organism.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Backbiting is pressured by veterinary pathology, burial, shared bodily tissue, and a concealed spark that turns circulating talk into social fire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Toxic Feeding Swells Within
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Appetite takes in harmful matter; concealed corruption develops internally as swelling near death.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: livestock swelling from toxic fodder `quranic:root_000289:B001/m01`; prepared food or prey `quranic:root_000043:B007/m01`; corrosion and bodily decay `quranic:root_000043:B006/m01`; appetite for meat `quranic:root_001348:B002/m01`; appetite pressed toward food `quranic:root_000268:B006/m01`; disease that eats the innards `quranic:root_001642:B001/m01`; internal swelling or fullness `quranic:root_001470:B006/m01`; hidden inward corruption `quranic:root_000464:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the swelling/invalidating root occurs at 49:2; the inward-disease root at 49:4; eating and flesh at 49:12; inward entry at 49:14; exertion/appetite at 49:15. Surface anchoring is unavailable for `quranic:root_001470:B006/m01` (`ن ب و`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This is a distinct consequence scene rather than another rendering of the corpse meal. Appetite receives harmful matter as food, but a disease eats the eater from within while hidden corruption swells toward collapse. The inversion makes socially appetitive speech look nourishing at intake and predatory after admission.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The inward person is a material core whose condition is disclosed by testing, adorned by attachment, and cultivated toward growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The heart becomes refined material, adorned interior, protected kernel, and worked field, while covering can either preserve growth or suppress truth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cultivated Ground Bears Grain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A cultivator works soft, watered earth until vegetation forms a seed-bearing crop.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: land occurs at 49:16 and 18; female/fertility, informed knowledge, and honor at 49:13; adornment at 49:7; flesh/crop at 49:12; road/grain at 49:15.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This is field cultivation rather than kernel protection. Soil, retained water, skilled labor, and a known share of yield supply setting, agent, process, and outcome. The scene pressures claims of inward faith by asking whether the interior has been worked into visible grain.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

error_profile.adds: Korkudan emin olma ve guvenilirlik alanlarini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Ayni kokun guven daliyla karisir.

error_profile.preserves: Kabul fikrine cok dolayli temas edebilir.
error_profile.loses: Dua icindeki sabit cevap sozunu ve kabul dilegini kaybettirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dua sonunda soylenen sabit kabul istegi sozudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalvarma, ihtiyac gostermek ve alttan yakarma halidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de dua ve talep sahnesinde yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal dua edenin duskun ve isteyen halini anlatir; bu dal ise duaya eklenen kabul dilegi sozunu adlandirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Duanin kabul edilmesini isteyen sabit sozdur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aksirana iyi dilekte bulunma ve ona hayir duasidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de kisa dua veya dua cevabi soylemleri alanindadir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal belirli sosyal durumda birine iyi dilek yoneltir; bu dal ise yapilmis duanin kabul edilmesi icin soylenen formulu anlatir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dua icinde kabul istegini bildiren belirli sozdur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dua onayi, pekistirme ve kinama gibi daha daginik soz islevlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de kisa sozlerle dua, onay veya pekistirme islevi gorebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal birden cok soz islevine yayilir; bu dal tekil olarak dua kabul istegi formulune baglidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dua cevabi olarak kabul istegi bildiren sozdur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Guven, korkusuzluk, emanet ve guvenilirlik alanidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ayni kok ailesinde yer alsalar da normal anlam alanlari ayridir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sabit dua sozunu ve onu soylemeyi anlatir; komsu dal korkunun kalkmasi ve guvenilirlik iliskilerini anlatir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dua sonunda kabul istegi bildiren sozdur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip kabul etmektir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kabul fikri cok genel duzeyde ikisine de temas edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir soylem formuludur; komsu dal bir haberin veya hakikatin dogrulanmasi ve benimsenmesidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yayinlanan ayrimlar dua, dua cevabi, yalvarma ve ayni kokteki iki ayri dali kapsar; kalan adaylar ibadet, kehanet araci veya uzak dua sozleri olarak daha az dogrudan sinir bilgisi verdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آمين في الدعاء بالمد والقصر، والتأمين بمعنى قول آمين، وتفسيرها باستجب أو اللهم افعل أو كذلك فليكن، مع ذكر قول من جعلها اسما من أسماء الله.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الأمن ضد الخوف، ولا الأمانة، ولا الإيمان بمعنى التصديق، ولا أمن التي هي أم من وليست من الباب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: قولنا في الدعاء آمين وتفسيره اللهم افعل (maqayis)؛ التأمين من قولك آمين (ayn)؛ آمين في الدعاء يمد ويقصر ومعناه كذلك فليكن (sihah)؛ آمين يقال بالمد والقصر وهو اسم للفعل ومعناه استجب وأمن فلان إذا قال آمين (mufradat)

Ortak bag kalbin yatismasi ve kabul duygusudur, fakat her dalin siniri guvenlik, tasdik ve dua formulu olarak ayri tutulmalidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanın veya hayvanın böğrünü, bir şeyin yanını ve bu temel anlamdan gelişen bitişik çevreyi birlikte doğrular. Vadi ve ordu gibi yapıların iki yanı ile böğürden alınan deri parçası, aynı yan bölge çekirdeğinin belirli uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca uzak durmayı değil, somut bir yanı, yan bölgeyi veya ona bitişik çevreyi bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; tanım, özel bir söz öbeğine bağlı anlamları çekirdeğe katmadan yan ve bitişik çevre alanını kapsar.

concept_map.definition: İnsan ya da hayvan gövdesinin böğrü veya herhangi bir şeyin yanı ve bu yana bitişik yakın çevredir. İki yandan oluşan düzenlerde her bir yanı, ayrıca böğürden alınan deri parçasını da adlandırabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninin böğrünü ve bir şeyin yanını ya da tarafını belirtir.
Bir evin veya topluluğun yerleşimine bitişik yakın çevreyi belirtebilir.
Vadi, ordu veya ırmak gibi bir bütünün iki yanından her birini belirtir.
Devenin böğründen alınan ve kap yapımında kullanılabilen deri parçasını belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Anlamın ortak çekirdeği bedenin veya bir nesnenin yanıdır. Yakın çevre, iki yandan biri ve böğür derisinden alınan parça bu mekansal çekirdeğin belirli uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: bedenin veya şeyin yanı ve bitişik çevresi
concept_gloss.applicability: Bedenin böğrü, bir nesnenin tarafı ve o tarafa bitişik yakın alan birlikte kastedildiğinde en uygun karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yan bölgeyi ve ona bitişik yakın çevre ilişkisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vadi, ordu veya ırmak gibi iki taraflı düşünülen yapıların karşılıklı yanları için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki taraflı bir bütünün karşılıklı yanlarını eksiksiz belirtir.
